C1366.title: Horizon Bridge Attack
C1366.summary: On June 24, 2022, Harmony reported the theft of approximately $100 million in virtual assets from its Horizon bridge. In 2023, the FBI confirmed that the North Korea-linked Lazarus Group, also known as APT38, was responsible and described subsequent efforts to move and launder portions of the stolen assets through privacy protocols and multiple wallets.

references.title: FBI Confirms Lazarus Group Cyber Actors Responsible for Harmony’s Horizon Bridge Currency Theft
